## How was it checked?

- [ ] `npm run check`

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] I did not commit credentials, personal data, confidential recordings, or generated local workflow/run data.
- [ ] I reviewed changes affecting capture, redaction, model requests, approval, execution, permissions, or logs.
- [ ] I updated documentation when behaviour or trust boundaries changed.
